start_pm:
👋 **Senpai**

Telegram groups mein Wordle ki tarah words guess karein.

Mujhe kisi group mein add karein aur try karein:
/new — random length game
/new4, /new5, /new6 — specific length chunein
/game — current game ki info dekhein
/leaderboard — is group ke top players
/userprofile — aapke personal stats
start_gc:
👋 **Senpai** zinda hai aur khelne ke liye taiyaar hai!

Naya game shuru karne ke liye /new dabayein, ya aur jankari ke liye neeche diye buttons par click karein.
game_already_running:
⚠️ Is group mein pehle se ek game chal raha hai.

Naya game shuru karne se pehle current game ko poora karein ya end karein.
